relationships.subject: Morin
relationships.evidence_quote: find Morin which is the inhibitor of TXNIP can attenuates pyroptosis of nucleus pulposus cells and ameliorates intervertebral disc degeneration

key_findings: TXNIP promotes pyroptosis of nucleus pulposus cells via NLRP3/Caspase-1/IL-1β signaling and aggravates intervertebral disc degeneration.
Morin, a TXNIP inhibitor, suppresses the TXNIP/NLRP3/Caspase-1 pathway and ameliorates disc degeneration.
